title: ORTHOPANTOMOGRAPH OP 3D EX
html:
ORTHOPANTOMOGRAPH OP 3D EX from DEXIS was named one of Dentistry Today’s 2026 Readers’ Choice Top 50 Technology Products.

Comprehensive 3D Imaging Platform Enables Confident Diagnosing

Built on the OP 3D family technology, the ORTHOPANTOMOGRAPH OP 3D EX is a complete x-ray platform designed for general practitioners looking to expand their practice with 3D imaging.

The OP 3D EX makes it easy to capture high-quality images with fast scan times while providing user-friendly features throughout the entire dental imaging workflow. Analyze clear, accurate 3D scans and diagnose with confidence thanks to the flexible field-of-view sizes and advanced filters, both in the device as well as within DTX Studio Clinic. Examples of some filters include Metal Artifact Reduction (MAR) and Implant Contrast Enhancement (ICE), and Edge-Preserving Noise Reduction (EPNR).

The exposure switch comes with an improved, ergonomic design and a light indicator that shows the device status (ready, exposing) making it more user-friendly and efficient. Adjustable remote-control sounds are also included.

The OP 3D EX offers a HD Pan for the adult panoramic program and has a 15-second scan time, sharper images with less noise, and higher definition compared to standard scans, with the flexibility to select normal or HD mode as a default setting.

The OP 3D EX is completely upgradeable with cephalometric imaging including the Ceph arm assembly and 3D sensor.

For more information, call (888) 883-3947 or visit dexis.com.

I needed a unit with a large sensor, predictable acquisition, good image quality, and intuitive software that wouldn’t slow me down. Once the OP 3D EX got here and we started taking some scans, I thought, ‘Ok, wait…we made a REALLY good choice here.

—Tyler Tolbert, DMD
